DataExportOrderDetail.description_en: The information about the data export ticket
DataExportOrderDetail.description_zh: SQL结果集导出工单详情信息

JobStatus.description_en:
The state of the data export ticket. Valid values:

PRE_CHECKING: The ticket was being prechecked.
PRE_CHECK_SUCCESS: The ticket passed the precheck.
PRE_CHECK_FAIL: The ticket failed to pass the prechecked.
WAITING_APPLY_AUDIT: The ticket was to be submitted for approval.
APPLY_AUDIT_SUCCESS: The ticket was submitted for approval.
ENABLE_EXPORT: The ticket was approved. Data can be exported.
WAITING_EXPORT: Data was to be scheduled for export.
DOING_EXPORT: Data was being exported.
EXPORT_FAIL: Data failed to be exported.
EXPORT_SUCCESS: Data was exported
JobStatus.description_zh:
导出工单状态，取值如下：
PRE_CHECKING：执行预校验。
PRE_CHECK_SUCCESS：预校验成功。
PRE_CHECK_FAIL：预校验失败。
WAITING_APPLY_AUDIT：等待提交审批。
APPLY_AUDIT_SUCCESS：提交审批成功。
ENABLE_EXPORT：审批通过，允许导出。
WAITING_EXPORT：等待调度进行导出。
DOING_EXPORT：执行导出。
EXPORT_FAIL：导出失败。
EXPORT_SUCCESS：导出成功

ActualAffectRows.description_en: The number of rows that were affected by the SQL statement

Classify.description_en: The category of the reason for the data export

Database.description_en: The name of the database from which data was exported

DbId.description_en: The ID of the database from which data was exported

EnvType.description_en: The type of the environment to which the database belongs

ExeSQL.description_en: The SQL statement that was executed to export data

IgnoreAffectRows.description_en: Indicates whether the affected rows are skipped

IgnoreAffectRowsReason.description_en: The reason why the affected rows are skipped

Logic.description_en: Indicates whether the database is a logical database

Success.description_en:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
